errors.message: line 1: this line is not inside an effect. Start one first with "effect <name>:".
line 2: put a colon after the effect name: "effect fog:".
line 3: there is no trig9 on this board. The inputs are trig1, trig2 and user1 to user3.
line 4: rly1 can only be on or off, not 50%. Dimming works on out1 to out4.
line 5: "bright" is not a level. Use on, off or a percentage from 0% to 100%.
line 6: "later" is not a time. Write seconds (sleep 2.5) or add a unit: ms, s or min.
